Class CardStateJSON

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Model.ActionJSON.ActionJSON
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Model.ActionJSON.CardStateJSON
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CardStateJSON extends ActionJSON
This class needs to contain all the attribute that can be used by the clients to interact with the cards We can just use this single class to cover all the desired data
